title: HostObject
description: `HOTDESKING_GUEST` endpoints include the `host` element when the user has an active hotdesking session on a host.

autoAndForcedAnswerEnabled.description: If `true`, the endpoint can be remotely controlled, allowing actions such as mute, hold, resume and answer.

ownerId.description: Unique identifier of the endpoint owner.

secondaryLines.description: List of secondary lines. The secondary line information is not returned for the endpoint owned by an entity other than the authenticated user.
